text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Alright, keep going like this—kyaa?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Ouch! Did something get in? ...I can't 
see properly...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, that's Eye-senpai's presence! Sense 
my surroundings so we don't collide—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can Almond Eye reach her? How will it end! 
Gran Alegria crosses the finish line 
first!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Gran Alegria won! She actually beat 
Almond Eye?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: S-She won... Gran-chan did...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, regarding Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I can win... Even against a legendary 
opponent...! There's a path... to 
victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan found it! If Gran-chan, who 
shared the same time and walked the same 
path as us, could do it—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even I must have one...! A path that leads 
to victory...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I beat the strongest, Almond Eye... Which 
means, Gran Alegria is the strongest...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, just winning at the mile doesn't make 
you the strongest! You gotta win at middle 
distance—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Mile races, Gran-chan's greatest 
weapon. Yes, that's it...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Must be nice. That golden bouquet Gran 
held in her hands—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to give something, too...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't nearly enough! Not just speed! 
Everything, absolutely everything!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was my own complacency...! Ugh... it's 
so frustrating...! So frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was a mile, and against Gran-chan, no 
less! I had to run a flawless race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Not a single mistake is permitted, you 
say? That strictness is so like you, 
Eye-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
She's plenty strong even now, yet she's 
still trying to become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Next time... next time 
for sure! I'll deliver a perfect run! 
Without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm going to get even stronger 
too! I'll be the one to win next time!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm the one who's going to win! 
Definitely, absolutely!! I will beat you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I beat Ai-senpai!
choice_data_list: If it's Gran Alegria, of course!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!
choice_data_list:
Still, that's amazing! You're truly 
incredible, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you so much for the infinite 
miles of praise♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria-san, congratulations on your 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for the fan service! 
What an adorable wink!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that. Some dirt got in my 
right eye during the race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm totally fine! I'm just rolling 
around for 0.4 miles.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
0.4 miles? 640... u-um! What do you think 
was the key to your victory today?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it is because I was able to 
maintain my usual routine? I carried out 
my personal rules thoroughly, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: What are "My Rules"...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, first off... "Relaxing to radio 
broadcasts of the National Diet"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There's no live broadcast on Sundays, so I 
bring recorded tapes with me!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I, see...? W-Well then, please tell us 
your thoughts going forward.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is conquering all three tiers! I 
know I can do it! Because—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
0.75 miles or 1.25 miles, they're 
basically still a mile anyway!
choice_data_list:
(Everyone looks confused, but will it be 
okay...?)

text_block_list.text:
"...Contrary to my worries, however, Gran 
Alegria's interview was broadcast 
completely unedited."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wha, what what what!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, notifications? They're going off so 
much it's scary!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A message on Umastagram? Who's this? Huh, 
it's all complete strangers!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I don't get it! Trainer, help me~~~!!

For now, I muted my phone's notifications 
and opened Umastagram to check.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...That Yasuda Kinen press conference was 
funny. Why is a mile the unit of 
measurement?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Is your right eye okay? Your wink was 
super cute though♡"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"『Nice to meet you, just followed! If you 
have any other personal rules, please let 
us know!』"
choice_data_list:
W-Well... your thoughts on the Yasuda 
Kinen press conference, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It seems so. ...Whoa, her follower count 
is in a whole different league from miles!

There should be a video of the Yasuda 
Kinen press conference. Opening the 
webpage—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Gran Alegria is just too unique. 
Miles, my-rules... what else does she 
have?"
choice_data_list:
"I wonder if she lives her daily life in 
miles too."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally obsessed with Gran-chan♡ Tell 
me all about her~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: O... Oooohhh!?

Once I got a full grasp of the situation— 
it turned out the video of Gran Alegria's 
press conference blew up because people 
loved her "character."

It seemed that people whose interest was 
piqued by Gran Alegria flooded her 
Umastagram account.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I just had a 7-mile flash of 
inspiration!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"With all eyes on me right now, maybe we 
can use this situation to our advantage."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Look, remember how we were wondering how 
to spread Master's teachings?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's going viral, my post's reach 
has a range of 500 miles!

"Right now, the public is eager to learn 
more about Gran Alegria's personality and 
daily life."

If we share information about her from our 
side, we should be able to spread the word 
to a lot of people!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you stream videos of your daily 
training, you can really convey the "Horse 
Girls First" spirit!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Phew! My Rule Number 12!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To finish off our roadwork, we do the 
"GIRLS' LEGEND U" pose in the stands!
choice_data_list: OK, I got a great shot!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aah, come on, Gran-chan, you shouldn't 
tell lies~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You always follow that personal rule 
together with your Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Then we've gotta do videos together too!

Her name is Curren Chan. The very 
embodiment of cuteness and a famous 
Umastagrammer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Will that make it go more viral?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ Because even you having 'My Rules' 
too would be super hilarious, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Aaargh, fine! Let's do this, Gran!
Aaargh, fine! Let's do this, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, adding subtitles to the video is 17 
miles harder than I thought...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it stayed in hiragana! Now I have to 
retype it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think leaving it in hiragana is just 
fine. It's cute, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I think making your first video a bit more 
casual will help get it seen by more 
people!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wooww! Now that you mention it, that's so 
true! That's a 2-mile eye-opener!

With the help of Umamusume skilled in 
social media, like the odd-couple sprinter 
duo of Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus—

Gran Alegria began sharing updates online, 
including snippets of the training 
routines she had inherited from her 
master.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's "Road to Conquering Three 
Distance Classes"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the mile in the Yasuda 
Kinen, her next challenge will be—sprints!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"It's the Sprinters Stakes! I'll give it 
my all at a blazing 120 miles per hour!"
